_source_note: Transcribed verbatim from screenshots of the Google Business Profile, captured 2026-08-16. Wording, punctuation and capitalisation are exactly as written by the reviewer, including typos and lowercase display names. All twenty are five stars.
_date_note: Google showed relative timestamps for reviews under a year old and absolute dates beyond that. Relative ones are converted against the 2026-08-16 capture date and are accurate to within a week. Absolute ones are exact.
_avatar_note: Four reviewer photos supplied and matched to their reviews by visual comparison against the profile screenshots: Peter Geltman, Wayne Marshall, Kent & Jacquelyn Seeley and Mike Cogs. The rest use the initial fallback, which is what their Google profiles show anyway.
_todo: profile_url is still needed for the read-every-review link. rating and count stay null until the true profile totals are known.

reviews.author: David Tuvlin
reviews.text: Matt was a pleasure to work with and did a great job detailing my 24' Grady White. Matt made himself super available to see the boat, get me a quote and get the job done

reviews.author: Bill Viggiano
reviews.text: Matt and team compounded and waxed my boat today....very pleased with the outcome. They were very meticulous , and ensured the entire site and boat stayed clean. Recommend them to anyone looking to have their vessel detailed.

reviews.author: Matt Kemish
reviews.text: Matt and his team did a great job bringing the shine back on my 2001 boat. Matt's communication was fantastic and his pricing was very reasonable. I highly recommend using Matt's services.

reviews.author: Joshua S
reviews.text: Matt of Matt's Boat Detailing (MBD) is the real deal. He cleaned up a mess that a different detailer made. With Phase I complete, my boat looks great! I am so happy I finally got to use his services. He is a hands on owner operator which I think is very important. He took the time to visit and advise as well as inspect the final work making adjustments as necessary. He knows what he is doing and he and his crew even properly prepped to protect neighboring surfaces, which most boat detailers are too lazy to do. I am looking forward to him completing Phase II and using his services moving forward! I will be recommending him to everyone I know that is looking for boat detailing services.

reviews.author: Jan Young
reviews.text: This is the third year that Matt and his crew have detailed my 33' Cruisers. I have been thoroughly pleased every year and would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tammy Russo-Jensen
reviews.text: You get what you pay for! Matt's services fully lived up to my lofty expectations and my boat looks better than when leaving the showroom. Matt will be my go to guy for any detail related jobs I may require in the future.

reviews.author: Kent & Jacquelyn Seeley
reviews.text: My Experience with Matt's details was truly top notch! First off I called him very late in the spring and he came up with a way to get my Hull done to follow up with the super structure once in the water. This year I opted to go with not only a compound and seal but also went down the ceramic coating route in hopes of getting an extra year out of the job. First off his pricing is very competitive compared to few others I checked. Matts work was amazing and the boat looks brand new! Lastly, his communication was spot on. As with any spring/early summer project in New England, we had plenty of weather related issues. He kept me posted every step of the way, touched base with any reschedules, let me know when he got there, and lastly when he left. I could not be more pleased with my decision to use Matts Detailing and will be a return customer for sure next year to “touch up”. I highly recommend reaching out to Matt for any detailing work!
